_note: The founder's product brief. These are the only facts Quinn may use in a post; anything else is blocked by the claim check.

facts.what: WarmPath is a team of AI agents that turns buying intent in LinkedIn comments into meetings.
facts.intent: Quinn reads the comments on a post and separates real buying intent from praise.
facts.relationship: Jordan checks Gmail and Calendar for an existing relationship with the commenter's company, matched by email domain rather than company name.
facts.claims: Casey writes the follow-up, and every sentence must cite something the team actually read, or it is not sent.
facts.approval: Nothing goes out without the founder's approval in Slack or in the app.
facts.meetings: Morgan offers real free times from the calendar and books only a time the prospect accepts.
facts.addresses: WarmPath never guesses an email address; without a verified one it replies on LinkedIn instead.
facts.audit: Every run is audited against each agent's written instructions, and a broken rule becomes a regression test.
facts.who_for: Founders and small sales teams who lose warm leads because they forget who they already know.
